InfoSec, SBOM & Air-Gap Architecture

Security, Dual-Signing & Zero-Telemetry Pledge

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is compiled strictly from first-party C++20 source with cl.exe /MT and the stock Windows 11 SDK—linking only OS-resident System32 libraries with zero third-party packages, zero outbound network telemetry, and zero cryptocurrency/blockchain dependencies.

Four Pillars of Supply-Chain Trust

1. Static /MT Compilation & Minimal SBOM

No NuGet graph, no npm runtime, no Electron Chromium bundle, and no external DLLs. Both the build tools and SetupWizard.exe call Microsoft's OS-serviced msi.dll, cabinet.dll, and bcrypt.dll directly.

2. Dual-Layer Authenticode Code Signing

When [Signing] Enabled = true, instbuild.exe signs the inner Product.msi first, embeds the signed database into Setup.exe via UpdateResourceW, and signs the outer executable—supporting both local HSM thumbprints and Azure Artifact Signing.

3. Prism-Piercing OS & Silicon Verification

Calls RtlGetVersion inside ntdll.dll (bypassing GetVersionEx manifest shims) and IsWow64Process2 to detect true ARM64 vs. x64 silicon even under Windows 11 Prism emulation.

4. Permanent Zero-Telemetry & Zero-Crypto Pledge

Neither InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, msiprism.exe, nor SetupWizard.exe opens a network socket, phones home to a license server, or bundles cryptocurrency payment code.
